title: Tooltips show the key in keycaps
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation and rest the pointer on the check mark beside the subject
Move straight to the clock, then the bell, then the down arrow
Rest on the reply arrow in a message header, then on the small chevron after the recipients and click it
expected: After about half a second a dark pill (light in Dark) shows the action and its key in keycaps (Mark done E; Snooze, Remind me; Next conversation J; Reply R). The next button's tip shows at once. The chevron's tip says Show details with no key; a click shows the From, To and date block. One tip at a time, inside the window, never over its button.
